message_bodies:
Hi Samir and Asha,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — HorizonAI's use case (real-time summarization of streaming clinical notes) maps well to our low-latency batching and cache features. To accelerate evaluation I'd like to propose the following one-time package for a 60-day POC:

- $10,000 free credits applied to tokens (usable across hosted/dedicated variants)
- 30% promotional discount on first-year committed Dedicated capacity if Horizon converts within 90 days
- Dedicated onboarding support and priority slots for the pilot

This is a bit outside standard playbooks, so I'll need exec approval for the combined credits + discount exception. Attachment: horizon_po_term_sheet.xlsx (PO template) and a draft MPA (redlined items are minimal).

If this looks reasonable I can kick off procurement paperwork and schedule a kickoff for next week.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: horizon_po_term_sheet.xlsx

Michael —

Appreciate the proposal. Procurement here needs a written confirmation that the credits are one-time and that the 30% discount is an exception requiring executive sign-off from Redwood (we can't approve large discounts purely from vendor reps). Please escalate; we'll hold the PO pending an exec confirmation email and the full MPA.

Can you share the specific cancellation/rollback conditions and any minimum commit that triggers the discount?

- Samir
Director, Cloud Platforms, HorizonAI
procurement@horizon.ai

Hi Marissa,

Forwarding an ask from HorizonAI — strong strategic account, potential ARR $1.2M+ if they migrate key workloads to Dedicated. Procurement explicitly asked for an exec note on the one-time 30% discount + $10k POC credit.

Why this exception:
- Competitive urgency (competitor X has offered a shorter trial window)
- High technical fit for our low-latency offering and cache savings
- Short time-to-value: they can decide within 60–90 days

Proposed guardrails:
- 60-day evaluation window with a 90-day conversion window for the discount to apply
- Discount only applies to the first-year committed spend; billing triggers must be tied to PO and signed MPA
- Credits expire at end of POC and are non-refundable

I've CC'd Grace (SE) and Marcus (Finance) for cost impact. Requesting a one-email exec approval we can forward to procurement. Draft terms attached.

Thanks,
Michael

Thanks for the context. I'm comfortable approving the combination conditionally. Approve on the following conditions:

3) Finance (Marcus) must confirm the projected margin impact and sign the MPA. Legal to do a quick pass on the rollback clause.

Samir / Asha —

Good news: executive approval granted. Conditions are as follows and reflected in the attached MPA draft (horizon_redwood_mpa_draft.pdf):

- $10,000 one-time POC credit, expires at the end of the 60-day pilot window.
- 30% promotional discount applied to the first-year Dedicated commitment if a PO is signed within 90 days of pilot start.

- Finance and Legal have been looped for a final stamp — Marcus will confirm margin impact and Legal will issue final redline by EOD tomorrow.

Next steps: Please confirm acceptance of these conditions and send an initial PO to procurement@redwood.com. Once received, our onboarding team will provision priority capacity and schedule the kickoff session.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.
